guest.notes: this is the one legacy ios target with a genuine oss emulation path, because the hardware is an arm1176 soc that hobbyists have already ported

oss_paths: nvsio/qemu-ios (gpl2, qemu s5l89xx port, forks of DJHartley/QEMU-s5l89xx-port)

media.note: iphone os 3 ipsw is apple's: owner-supplied, never shipped, never mirrored

activation.note: no activation server dependency at this vintage

constraints: the port is a fork of an abandoned qemu tree: expect to build an old toolchain before it runs at all
armv6 only and no store: applications arrive as packages the owner already has, not as downloads
expect kernel and partial userspace rather than a finished springboard: verify what actually renders before claiming a screen
clock is frozen by design: the era's software has no idea what year it is, and a jumped clock changes behaviour
no attestation and no account services at this vintage, so anything that needs them is out of scope
